description: Use this when asked whether a service delivered what was agreed ("did the supplier deliver?"). Pass the `terms_id` from witness_register_terms and mode PUBLIC_REPLAY (GAIP fetches it) or BUYER_SUBMITTED. Returns PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN per check, what changed since last time, and a receipt. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

body.description: BUYER_SUBMITTED: the response body you received (max 32 KiB).

body_sha256.description: BUYER_SUBMITTED: SHA-256 of the body, instead of the body.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones.

data_classification.description: PUBLIC (default) or NON_PERSONAL_PUBLIC. Never send personal data.

episode_id.description: Optional: your own id to group related calls.

http_status.description: BUYER_SUBMITTED: the HTTP status you received.

independent_operator_id.description: Optional: your operator id (recorded as a claim, not verified).

mode.description: PUBLIC_REPLAY: GAIP fetches the public URL itself. BUYER_SUBMITTED: check a response you pass in.

synthetic.description: Optional: true marks a test call.

terms_id.description: The terms_id returned when the terms were registered.

name: witness_delivery
title: Did the service deliver?
